title: 345. Lowest Common Ancestor of a Binary Tree

examples.explanation: Nodes 5 and 1 sit in opposite subtrees of 3, so the ancestor is 3.
Node 4 is inside the subtree of 5, so the ancestor is 5 itself.
Node 2 is a direct child of 1, so the ancestor is 1.
